title: Coherent space-valued presheaves and their constructed Yoneda functor
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal U$ and use simplicial sets and their order-reversing opposite, coherent functor simplicial sets and Kan complexes as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the subset-poset coherent nerve of [def-coef-coherent-nerve-infrastructure], and the infinity category $\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$, singular-realization enrichment and enriched unit of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces]. For a $\mathcal U$-small simplicial set $D$, set $A=\mathfrak C[D]$, using the simplex-colimit rigidification of [lem-coef-pinched-rigidification-resolution], and put $\mathcal P(D)=\operatorname{Fun}(D^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S_{\mathcal U})$, formed in the next universe. Define the coherent Hom pairing $D^{\mathrm{op}}\times D\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$ as follows. For an $n$-simplex $(s,t)$, regard both $s$ and $t$ as enriched functors $\mathfrak C[\Delta^n]\to A$ by the rigidification unit, with $s$ the underlying simplex before order reversal. At vertex $i$ take $\operatorname{Sing}|A(s(n-i),t(i))|$. On the enriched Hom from $i$ to $j$, reflect its endpoint-containing subset paths by $k\mapsto n-k$, apply $s$ to obtain the precomposing morphism $s(n-j)\to s(n-i)$, and apply $t$ to the original paths to obtain the postcomposing morphism $t(i)\to t(j)$. Apply the enriched unit $A\to A^{\mathrm{top}}$ to both morphisms; precomposition followed by postcomposition in $A^{\mathrm{top}}$ gives the enriched map between the displayed Kan complexes. Reflection preserves singleton paths and carries unions to unions with reversed endpoints, so these maps obey the enriched identity and composition laws. Reflection commutes with image of subsets under reversed ordinal maps, and the rigidification unit is natural; consequently this formula commutes with every simplicial operator. Define $y_D:D\to\mathcal P(D)$ to be the exponential transpose of this Hom pairing. For a quasicategory this is the Yoneda functor $d\mapsto\operatorname{Map}_D(-,d)$ in the Sing-realization rigidification model. This definition claims neither full faithfulness nor density.

lean.note: Explicit subset-path reflection and pre/postcomposition in the existing singular-realization rigidification enrichment construct the whole coherent Hom pairing. Its exponential transpose is Yoneda. The only postponed proofs are its named enriched-functor laws and simplicial naturality; no data is sorry and no map is chosen from existence. Reuses existing infinityCategory, rigidification, topEnrichment and corepresentedValue.
